description: Seed corpus of the training-science library (#116). Every source was checked against its live Crossref record, and PubMed record when indexed, on the ingestion date. Summaries are in our own words and unreviewed.

debates.question: Does muscle growth keep rising with more weekly sets, and where do the returns flatten?
Does training a muscle more often per week help beyond the extra volume it allows?
How close to failure do sets need to end for strength and for hypertrophy?
Do longer rests between sets give more hypertrophy and strength than short rests?
Do planned deloads improve results, or only how training feels?
Does periodizing training add strength or hypertrophy over non-periodized training of equal volume?
Is full range of motion better than partial range, including partials at long muscle lengths?
